name: Ship Schedules
summary: At Steamwheedle Port, some voyages bear marks on the ship schedule. It belongs with someone in authority there.

sections.title: The Scroll
sections.body: Ships sail between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay, and the scroll names them all. It records voyages already made and those still to come. Large X marks cross some journeys. Notes beside others warn of plunder or a hard fight. Someone in authority at Steamwheedle Port needs the schedule.

sections.title: The Port's Reaction
sections.body: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle checks the schedule and finds its dates and times accurate. He fears what a pirate captain could do with that knowledge. When you tell him you took it from a pirate, Bilgewhizzle calls the news disturbing and thanks you. He is glad the pirate is dead.

faq.q: What is written on the schedule?
aliases: what does the ship schedule say
faq.answer: The schedule names ships and records past and future voyages between Steamwheedle Port and Booty Bay. Large X marks cross some journeys, and other notes mention plunder or a hard fight.

faq.q: Who needs to see this document?
aliases: who do i give the schedule to
faq.answer: Someone in authority at Steamwheedle Port needs the schedule. Security Chief Bilgewhizzle takes it.
